en.t: "Ah... the question is whether I will collapse from illness...

units.source_text: 到今天为止，基本上没有病倒，反而坚持过来了，

en.t: Up to today, I basically have not collapsed; on the contrary, I have held out this far,

units.source_text: 连我自己也觉得不可思议。

en.t: and even I myself find it hard to believe.

units.source_text: 我倒不是考虑什么特别深奥的问题，

en.t: It is not that I am thinking about anything especially profound,

units.source_text: 也不是有什么称得上信仰的东西，

en.t: nor do I have anything that could be called faith,

units.source_text: 但光凭棋手的责任感是坚持不了的。

en.t: but one cannot keep going on a player's sense of responsibility alone.

units.source_text: 啊，可能是某种精神力量，实在是……”

en.t: Ah, perhaps it is some kind of spiritual strength; truly..."

units.source_text: 他微低着头，慢条斯理地说，

en.t: He lowered his head slightly and spoke in a slow, composed manner,

units.source_text: “归根结底，也许是我感觉迟钝。

en.t: "In the end, perhaps I am simply dull in my feelings.

units.source_text: 这样一想，我反而觉得好了。

en.t: and when I think of it that way, I actually feel better.

units.source_text: 发呆的意思，在大阪和东京有不同的解释。

en.t: The meaning of being absent-minded is understood differently in Osaka and Tokyo.

units.source_text: 在东京，一说发呆，就是有点愚蠢的意思；

en.t: In Tokyo, when people say absent-minded, it means something like a little foolish;

units.source_text: 可在大阪，以画画来说，意思是说这儿画得有点朦胧；

en.t: but in Osaka, speaking of painting, it means that this part is painted a little hazily;

units.source_text: 以下棋来说，这儿下得心不在焉，是不是？”

en.t: and speaking of playing go, it means this move was played with one's mind elsewhere, does it not?"
